```{r}
# Loaded necessary libraries
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(readxl)
library(pheatmap)
library(wordcloud2)

# Read cleaned dataset from Excel
ddata <- read_excel("CLEANING DATA DRUG.xlsx", sheet = "DATA_FINAL_ANALYSIS")
ddata <- ddata %>% mutate(Education_Level = gsub("Final$", "", Education_Level_Final))

personality_traits <- c("Neuroticism","Extraversion","Openness","Agreeableness",
                        "Conscientiousness","Impulsivity","Sensation_Seeking")

drug_cols <- c(
  "Caffeine_Use", "Nicotine_Use", "Alcohol_Use", "Chocolate_Use",
  "Cocaine_Use", "Ketamine_Use", "Heroin_Use", "LSD_Use"
)

# convert drug labels into uppercase, prettier labels for heatmaps
pretty_drug_labels <- function(mat) {
  labels <- colnames(mat)
  labels <- gsub("_", " ", labels)
  toupper(labels)
}

# create heatmap matrix by Age+Education and drug use counts
make_heat_matrix <- function(df) {
  tab <- df %>%
    count(AgeEdu, Drug, name = "Users") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Drug, values_from = Users, values_fill = 0)
  mat <- as.matrix(tab[, -1])
  rownames(mat) <- tab$AgeEdu
  mat
}

ddata_long <- ddata %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(drug_cols),
               names_to = "Drug",
               values_to = "Use_Status") %>%
  mutate(
    Drug = gsub("_Use$", "", Drug),
    Drug_Type = ifelse(Drug %in% c("Caffeine","Nicotine","Alcohol","Chocolate"),
                       "Legal", "Illegal")
  )

d_long <- ddata_long %>%
  mutate(AgeEdu = paste(Age_Group, Education_Level, sep = "_"))

# Heatmap matrices
mat_all    <- make_heat_matrix(d_long)
mat_male   <- make_heat_matrix(filter(d_long, Gender == "Male"))
mat_female <- make_heat_matrix(filter(d_long, Gender == "Female"))

# Color palettes
overall_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#FFFFFF", "#b38bff"))(100)
male_colors    <- colorRampPalette(c("#FFFFFF", "#6bb6ff"))(100)
female_colors  <- colorRampPalette(c("#FFFFFF", "#ff8ac6"))(100)

# Dropdown choices for distribution plots
dist_choices <- c("Gender" = "Gender", "Age Group" = "Age_Group", "Education Level" = "Education_Level")
facet_choices <- dist_choices

# UI (user interface)
ui <- dashboardPage(
  skin = "black",
  
  dashboardHeader(
    title = tags$div(
      style="background: linear-gradient(to right, #E9006D, #BCB8F0);
             padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 16px; white-space: normal;",
      "Drug Use & Personality Dashboard"
    )
  ),
  
  dashboardSidebar(
    sidebarMenu(
      menuItem("Data Distribution", tabName = "overview", icon = icon("chart-pie")),
      menuItem("Histogram", tabName = "hist", icon = icon("chart-bar")),
      menuItem("Boxplot", tabName = "box", icon = icon("box")),
      menuItem("Heatmaps", tabName = "heat", icon = icon("th")),
      menuItem("Word Cloud", tabName = "wordcloud", icon = icon("cloud")) 
    ),
    hr(),
    h4("Histogram Controls"),
    selectInput("facet_var", "Facet by:", choices = facet_choices, selected = "Gender"),
    checkboxGroupInput("drug_type_filter_hist", "Drug Type:", choices = c("Legal","Illegal"), selected = c("Legal","Illegal")),
    hr(),
    h4("Boxplot Controls"),
    selectInput(
  "trait",
  "Personality Trait:",
  choices = setNames(personality_traits, gsub("_", " ", personality_traits)),
  selected = personality_traits[1]
),

    checkboxGroupInput("drug_type_filter_box", "Drug Type:", choices = c("Legal","Illegal"), selected = c("Legal","Illegal"))
  ),
  
  dashboardBody(
    tabItems(
      # Overview tab
      tabItem(tabName = "overview",
        fluidRow(
          valueBoxOutput("total_participants"),
          valueBoxOutput("total_legal_drugs"),
          valueBoxOutput("total_illegal_drugs")
        ),
        fluidRow(
          box(title = "Distribution Selector", width = 4, status = "primary", solidHeader = TRUE,
              selectInput("dist_var", "Choose variable:", choices = dist_choices, selected = "Gender")),
          box(title = "Pie Chart", width = 8, status = "info", solidHeader = TRUE,
              plotlyOutput("pie_dist", height = "350px"))
        ),
        fluidRow(
          box(title = "Distribution Barplot", width = 12, status = "primary", solidHeader = TRUE,
              plotlyOutput("dist_bar", height = "400px"))
        )
      ),
      
      # Histogram tab
      tabItem(tabName = "hist",
        fluidRow(
          box(title="Drug Use Histogram", width=12, status="primary", solidHeader=TRUE,
              plotlyOutput("hist_plot"))
        )
      ),
      
      # Boxplot tab
      tabItem(tabName = "box",
        fluidRow(
          box(title="Personality Traits Boxplot", width=12, status="primary", solidHeader=TRUE,
              plotlyOutput("box_plot"))
        )
      ),
      
        #wordcloud tab
      tabItem(tabName = "wordcloud",
              fluidRow(
                box(title = "Drug Users Word Cloud", width = 12, status = "primary",
                    solidHeader = TRUE, wordcloud2Output("wordcloud", height = "600px")
                )             
    )
  ),
      
      # Heatmap tab
      tabItem(tabName = "heat",
        fluidRow(
          box(title="Overall Heatmap", width=12, status="primary", solidHeader=TRUE,
              plotOutput("heat_all", height="600px"))
        ),
        fluidRow(
          box(title="Male Heatmap", width=12, status="info", solidHeader=TRUE,
              plotOutput("heat_male", height="600px"))
        ),
        fluidRow(
          box(title="Female Heatmap", width=12, status="warning", solidHeader=TRUE,
              plotOutput("heat_female", height="600px"))
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

# Server
server <- function(input, output) {
  
  # Value boxes
  output$total_participants <- renderValueBox({
    valueBox(nrow(ddata), "TOTAL PARTICIPANTS", icon = icon("users"), color = "fuchsia")
  })
  
 
# Total legal drugs
output$total_legal_drugs <- renderValueBox({
  legal_drugs <- intersect(unique(ddata_long$Drug), c("Caffeine","Nicotine","Alcohol","Chocolate"))
  
  valueBox(
    HTML(paste(legal_drugs, collapse = "<br>")),  
    "Legal",                                      
    icon = icon("capsules"),
    color = "blue"
  )
})

output$total_illegal_drugs <- renderValueBox({
  illegal_drugs <- intersect(unique(ddata_long$Drug), c("Cocaine","Ketamine","Heroin","LSD"))
  
  valueBox(
    HTML(paste(illegal_drugs, collapse = "<br>")),  
    "Illegal",                                      
    icon = icon("skull-crossbones"),
    color = "purple"
  )
})



  
  # Distribution barplot
output$dist_bar <- renderPlotly({
  df <- ddata %>%
    count(.data[[input$dist_var]]) %>%
    rename(category = 1, n = n)
  
  my_colors <- c("#ff8ac6", "#6bb6ff", "#b38bff", "darkgreen", "orange", "red")
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(category, -n), y = n, fill = category)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) + 
    labs(x = gsub("_", " ", input$dist_var),
         y = "Count",
         title = paste("Distribution of", gsub("_", " ", input$dist_var))) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  ggplotly(p)
})

  
  # Pie chart
output$pie_dist <- renderPlotly({
  df <- ddata %>%
    count(.data[[input$dist_var]]) %>%
    rename(category = 1, n = n)
  
  my_colors <- c("#ff8ac6", "#6bb6ff", "#b38bff", "darkgreen", "orange", "red")
  
  plot_ly(df, labels = ~category, values = ~n, type = "pie",
          textinfo = "label+percent", insidetextorientation = "radial",
          marker = list(colors = my_colors)) %>%
    layout(title = paste("Pie of", gsub("_", " ", input$dist_var)))
})

  
  # Histogram
  filtered_hist <- reactive({
    ddata_long %>% filter(Drug_Type %in% input$drug_type_filter_hist)
  })
  
  output$hist_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- filtered_hist() %>%
      mutate(Use_Status = stringr::str_to_title(gsub("_|-", " ", Use_Status)))
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Drug, fill = Use_Status)) +
      geom_bar(position="dodge", color="black") +
      facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", input$facet_var))) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=c("User"="#E9006D","Non User"="#BCB8F0")) +
      theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) +
      labs(x = "Drug", y = "Count", fill = "Use Status")
    ggplotly(p)
  })
  
  # wordcloud
 output$wordcloud <- renderWordcloud2({
  drug_user_counts <- ddata_long %>%
    filter(Use_Status == "User") %>%
    count(Drug, name = "freq") %>%
    arrange(desc(freq))

  wordcloud2(data = drug_user_counts,
             size = 0.7,
             color = rep(c("#BCB8F0", "#E9006D", "#6bb6ff"), length.out = nrow(drug_user_counts)),
             shape = "circle")
})

  
  # Boxplot
  filtered_box <- reactive({
    ddata_long %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(personality_traits), names_to = "Trait", values_to = "Score") %>%
      mutate(Usage = Use_Status, Category = Drug_Type) %>%
      filter(Trait == input$trait, Category %in% input$drug_type_filter_box)
  })

  output$box_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- filtered_box() %>% mutate(Score = as.numeric(Score))
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=Usage, y=Score, fill=Usage)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      facet_wrap(~Category) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=c("User"="#E9006D","Non-User"="#BCB8F0")) +
      theme_minimal(14)
    ggplotly(p)
  })
  
  # Heatmaps
  heat_all_obj <- pheatmap(mat_all, cluster_rows=FALSE, cluster_cols=FALSE,
                           labels_col=pretty_drug_labels(mat_all), color=overall_colors,
                           angle_col=0, silent=TRUE)
  heat_male_obj <- pheatmap(mat_male, cluster_rows=FALSE, cluster_cols=FALSE,
                            labels_col=pretty_drug_labels(mat_male), color=male_colors,
                            angle_col=0, silent=TRUE)
  heat_female_obj <- pheatmap(mat_female, cluster_rows=FALSE, cluster_cols=FALSE,
                              labels_col=pretty_drug_labels(mat_female), color=female_colors,
                              angle_col=0, silent=TRUE)
  # render heatmaps
  output$heat_all <- renderPlot({ grid::grid.draw(heat_all_obj$gtable) })
  output$heat_male <- renderPlot({ grid::grid.draw(heat_male_obj$gtable) })
  output$heat_female <- renderPlot({ grid::grid.draw(heat_female_obj$gtable) })
}

# Run app
shinyApp(ui, server)

```
